address: Antigua N-V, Navalmoral de la Mata, 10300, Spain
bio: A pleasant and somewhat unexpected surprise on an industrial estate on the outskirts of town (next to an MOT testing centre). Terrazita’s traditional cuisine focuses on quality ingredients, including excellent grilled meat and seafood. The daily set menu is particularly popular, complemented by an à la carte and an extensive tasting menu with an included wine pairing....
